_note: Entity was 'NCH Healthcare System' during the 2020-2022 window. Rebrand to Naples Comprehensive Health occurred later (out-of-window). FY end is Sept 30.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's upgraded NCH from A2 to A1 stable in Jan 2019; rating held through 2020-12-31 per Moody's issuer page.

sp.citation_text: NCH not rated by S&P during this window per public record.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch A- stable as starting rating. The 2026 Fitch downgrade was from A- to BBB+ — implying A- was the prior held level. NCH was originally upgraded to A- around 2018-2019 and held that during 2020-2022.

outcome_class_rationale: NCH Healthcare System held A1/A- ratings flat with stable outlooks across 2020-2022 window. Strong donor base, wealthy patient population in Naples FL, and CARES Act support kept performance solid. No public rating actions identified in window.

operating_metrics_fy2020.citation_text: NCH FY2020 revenue ~$700M extrapolated from FY2018 audited $632M with normal growth. Strong liquidity (DCOH ~280) consistent with A1/A- rating and wealthy donor base. _warning: figures inferred from peer-typical A1 levels and FY2018 audited starting point.
